tasks.title: Implement once-only sequential startup with real DI construction and lifetime barriers
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: AC-02 through AC-09: add the single CIS.Startup.IStartable identity; enroll only ordinary unkeyed singleton interface registrations; validate final descriptors and use standard actual-root scope validation, materialize the full sequence once before any startup, reference-deduplicate preserving first occurrence, directly await actual tasks sequentially and retain one operation/first host token and success/fault/cancel without replay. Establish the existing critical condition monitor before participant construction when installed; preserve useful sync/null-task/async/unexpected-cancel failure and neutral known host cancellation. Cancellation never certifies actual settlement; final publication belongs to the same operation's stopping boundary and supports the narrow HB completion connection. Include focused real-DI controlled unit tests, usage documentation and independent review. Do not add a DI framework, second provider, scan, priority, retry, custom graph validator or generic hook registry.
tasks.validation: Build affected Core/Unit projects and run focused meaningful Startup enrollment, empty sequence, late-constructor-zero-call, registration/dependency-order, held-task, ref/equal-by-value identity, alias/lifetime/scope-validation, concurrent/repeated terminal-entry, sync/null/async fault, host/unexpected cancellation and actual-settlement tests. Inspect operation retention before user code and no user code under control locks. Preserve existing module behavior and ordinary PerformanceObservation/ExtendedStress exclusions. Record exact native symbols/results and AC mapping, actual cost/storage and responsibility-growth review in this task. Root controller serializes shared builds. Host acceptance remains owned by the dependent integration task.
